description: Lunar 1.5 e-commerce on top of laravel/base + laravel/inertia-vue (Inertia storefront). Lunar 1.x stable pulls Filament 4 and owns its own admin panel, so this variant does NOT include laravel/filament; Filament 5 and Lunar 1.x cannot be installed together. The panel is registered at /admin by App\Domain\Providers\Filament\LunarPanelProvider (listed in bootstrap/providers.php, which this layer overwrites: the LAST layer of a variant owns that list) and keeps Lunar's default theme. config/lunar/cart.php replaces Lunar's CalculateLines cart pipeline step with App\Infrastructure\Lunar\Cart\CalculateLines (integer minor units, Money::ROUNDING), pinned against Lunar's results by tests. Overwrites app/Infrastructure/Models/User.php (LunarUser). After creating the app: `php artisan migrate`, `php artisan lunar:install` (default language, currency, channel, tax class and the first admin). Lunar config is not published; run `php artisan vendor:publish --tag=lunar` when it needs changing.
